en.s: Pope Gregory II (Latin: Gregorius II; 669 – 11 February 731) was the bishop of Rome from 19 May 715 to his death on 11 February 731. His defiance of Emperor Leo III the Isaurian as a result of the iconoclastic controversy in the Eastern Empire prepared the way for a long series of revolts, schisms, and civil wars that eventually led to the establishment of the temporal power of the popes.

zh.s: 教宗额我略二世（拉丁语：Gregorius II；669年—731年2月11日）于715年5月19日至731年2月11日担任罗马主教。他因东部帝国的圣像破坏争议而反抗利奥三世皇帝，为此后长期的叛乱、教会分裂和内战埋下伏笔，最终促成教宗世俗权力的建立。

en.s: Battle of the Oinousses Islands (Turkish: Koyun Adaları Muharebesi) was a medieval naval engagement in the Aegean Sea. The theatre of the battle was around Oinousses, a group of small islands between the island of Chios and Anatolia. The belligerents were the warlord Tzachas and the Byzantine Empire. Tzachas was a Turkish seaman who founded a quasi-independent principality around Smyrna (modern İzmir) in the late 11th century. Although not a member of the Seljuk house, his daughter was married to the Seljuk Sultan Kılıç Arslan I. He founded a maritime principality around Smyrna and he frequently campaigned on the Byzantine islands in east Aegean sea. After capturing the island of Lesbos, he planned to attack the island of Chios. There were 17 war ships and 33 clippers under his command. However upon learning about an approaching Byzantine fleet under the command of Niketas Kastamonites, he decided to fight. The battle on the 19 May 1090 continued until night.

zh.t: 奥伊努塞斯群岛海战（1090年）
zh.s: 奥伊努塞斯群岛海战（土耳其语：Koyun Adaları Muharebesi）是发生在爱琴海的一场中世纪海战，战场位于希俄斯岛和安纳托利亚之间的奥伊努塞斯群岛附近。交战双方是军阀察哈斯和拜占庭帝国。察哈斯是一名土耳其水手，11世纪末在士麦那（今伊兹密尔）附近建立了近乎独立的公国。他虽非塞尔柱家族成员，但女儿嫁给了塞尔柱苏丹基利杰阿尔斯兰一世。察哈斯建立海上政权后，频繁袭击爱琴海东部的拜占庭岛屿。攻占莱斯沃斯岛后，他计划进攻希俄斯岛，麾下有17艘战船和33艘快船。但得知尼基塔斯·卡斯塔莫尼特斯率领的拜占庭舰队正在接近后，他决定迎战。战斗于1090年5月19日持续到夜间。

en.s: The First Battle of Olmedo, between Castilian forces and those of Navarre and Aragon, took place on 19 May 1445 outside Olmedo in Castile (now in the province of Valladolid, Spain). The war was in part prompted by the decrees of John II of Castile and his aide Álvaro de Luna that rents, that is taxes, from the town of Medina del Campo would be paid to his administration, rather than that of John II of Aragon, also of Navarre. The latter king invaded Castile, aided by his brother Alfonso V of Aragón.

zh.s: 第一次奥尔梅多战役于1445年5月19日在卡斯蒂利亚奥尔梅多城外爆发，交战双方为卡斯蒂利亚军队和纳瓦拉、阿拉贡联军。战争的部分起因是卡斯蒂利亚国王胡安二世及其助手阿尔瓦罗·德·卢纳下令，将麦地那德尔坎波镇的租税交给卡斯蒂利亚王室，而不是阿拉贡国王兼纳瓦拉国王胡安二世。后者在兄弟阿拉贡国王阿方索五世的援助下入侵卡斯蒂利亚。

en.s: The Conquest of Uppsala (Swedish: Erövringen av Uppsala) was a part of the Swedish War of Liberation that took place on 19 May 1521. After defeating a Danish counter-attack outside Västerås, Vasa sent two of his military commanders, Jöns Olofsson and Lars Eriksson, to take control of the eastern province of Uppland.

zh.s: 乌普萨拉征服战（瑞典语：Erövringen av Uppsala）是瑞典解放战争的一部分，于1521年5月19日发生。古斯塔夫·瓦萨在韦斯特罗斯城外击退丹麦军队的反击后，派遣两名军事指挥官约恩斯·奥洛夫松和拉尔斯·埃里克松接管东部的乌普兰省。

en.s: The Battle of Summerdale (also called the Battle of Bigswell) was fought on 19 May 1529, and was the last battle to take place on Orkney soil. The battle took place on the boundary of the parishes of Orphir and Stenness in Mainland, Orkney (just south of Kirkwall). The battle was fought between the Sinclairs of Orkney and the Sinclairs of Caithness, who had the support of James V, King of Scotland.

zh.s: 萨默代尔战役又称比格斯韦尔战役，于1529年5月19日爆发，是奥克尼群岛上最后一场战役。战斗发生在梅恩兰岛奥菲尔和斯滕尼斯两个教区的交界处，位于柯克沃尔以南不远处。交战双方是奥克尼的辛克莱家族和凯斯内斯的辛克莱家族；凯斯内斯一方得到苏格兰国王詹姆斯五世支持。

en.s: The 1545–1546 Siege of Kawagoe Castle (河越城の戦い, Kawagoe-jyō no tatakai) was part of a failed attempt by the Uesugi clan to regain Kawagoe Castle from the Later Hōjō clan in the Sengoku period of Japan.

zh.s: 1545年至1546年的川越城围城战（河越城の戦い，Kawagoe-jyō no tatakai）是日本战国时期，上杉氏试图从后北条氏手中夺回川越城但未能成功的一次军事行动。

en.s: The Franco-Spanish War, from May 1635 to November 1659, was fought between France and Spain, each supported by various allies at different points. It consists of two distinct phases, the first from May 1635 to October 1648, which is considered a related conflict of the Thirty Years' War, the second continued until the Treaty of the Pyrenees in 1659.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法西战争从1635年5月持续到1659年11月，交战双方是法国和西班牙，双方在不同时期各有盟友支持。战争分为两个阶段：第一阶段从1635年5月持续到1648年10月，被视为与三十年战争相关的冲突；第二阶段一直持续到1659年签署《比利牛斯条约》。

en.s: The Battle of Rocroi, fought on 19 May 1643, was a major engagement of the Thirty Years' War between a French army, led by the 21-year-old Duke of Enghien (later known as the Great Condé) and Spanish forces under General Francisco de Melo only five days after the accession of Louis XIV to the throne of France after his father's death.

zh.s: 罗克鲁瓦战役于1643年5月19日爆发，是三十年战争期间的一场重要战役。交战双方是由21岁的昂吉安公爵（后来被称为“大孔代”）率领的法国军队，以及弗朗西斯科·德·梅洛将军指挥的西班牙军队。战役发生时，法国国王路易十四的父亲刚刚去世，路易十四即位仅五天。

en.s: The naval Battle of Dover , fought on 19 May 1652 (29 May 1652 Gregorian calendar), was the first engagement of the First Anglo-Dutch War between the navies of the Commonwealth of England and the United Provinces of the Netherlands. It proved to be an indecisive battle involving the flagships of Admirals Maarten Tromp and Robert Blake. Opinions about the outcome of that battle vary among historians of that period.

zh.s: 多佛海战于1652年5月19日（格里历5月29日）爆发，是第一次英荷战争中英格兰共和国海军与尼德兰联省共和国海军之间的首次交战。战斗没有分出胜负，双方旗舰分别由马尔滕·特罗普和罗伯特·布莱克海军上将指挥。后世历史学家对战斗结果的评价不一。

en.s: An English expeditionary force captured Spanish Jamaica in May 1655, during the Anglo-Spanish War of 1654–1660. It was part of an ambitious plan by Oliver Cromwell to undermine or obliterate Spanish dominance in the Americas and to acquire new colonies there, known as the Western Design. Although major settlements like Santiago de la Vega, now Spanish Town, were poorly defended and quickly occupied, resistance by escaped slaves, or Jamaican Maroons, continued in the interior.
en.n: The Invasion of Jamaica begins during the Anglo-Spanish War.

zh.s: 1655年5月，英军远征队在英西战争期间攻占西班牙属牙买加。这是奥利弗·克伦威尔“西方计划”的一部分，旨在削弱或摧毁西班牙在美洲的主导地位，并取得新的殖民地。包括圣地亚哥-德拉维加（今西班牙镇）在内的主要定居点防守薄弱，很快被占领；逃奴组成的牙买加马龙人仍在内陆继续抵抗。
zh.n: 牙买加入侵在英西战争期间开始。

en.t: John III Sobieski becomes king of Poland-Lithuania
en.s: John III Sobieski (Polish: Jan III Sobieski (Polish pronunciation: [ˈjan ˈtʂɛt͡ɕi sɔˈbʲɛskʲi]); Lithuanian: Jonas III Sobieskis (Lithuanian pronunciation: ['joːnäs so'bʲɛskis]); Latin: Ioannes III Sobiscius (Latin pronunciation: [joˈannɛs soˈbiʃiʊs]) 17 August 1629 – 17 June 1696) was King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1674 until his death in 1696. Born into Polish nobility, Sobieski was educated at the Jagiellonian University and toured Europe in his youth.

zh.t: 扬三世·索别斯基成为波兰—立陶宛国王
zh.s: 扬三世·索别斯基（波兰语：Jan III Sobieski；立陶宛语：Jonas III Sobieskis；拉丁语：Ioannes III Sobiscius；1629年8月17日—1696年6月17日）于1674年至1696年去世前担任波兰国王和立陶宛大公。他出身波兰贵族，曾就读于雅盖隆大学，年轻时游历欧洲。

en.s: The Battle of Turner's Falls, also known as the Peskeompscut massacre, was fought on May 19, 1676, during King Philip's War, in present-day Gill, Massachusetts, near a falls on the Connecticut River. The site is across the river from the village of Turners Falls. A band of English colonists under the command of Captain William Turner fell upon the poorly guarded Indian village of Peskeompscut near the falls at dawn, slaughtering many of its inhabitants. Many of the warriors in the camp escaped, and they regrouped with those from other nearby camps to harass the English retreat, during which Turner was killed.

zh.s: 特纳瀑布战役又称佩斯基奥姆普斯卡特大屠杀，于1676年5月19日在菲利普王战争期间爆发，地点在今马萨诸塞州吉尔附近的康涅狄格河瀑布一带，河对岸是特纳瀑布村。威廉·特纳上尉率领的英国殖民者突袭了瀑布附近防守薄弱的佩斯基奥姆普斯卡特原住民村庄，黎明时屠杀了许多居民。许多战士逃脱后与附近其他营地的人会合，沿途袭击撤退的英军，特纳也在撤退途中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Port Royal was fought on 19 May 1690 at Port Royal, the capital of Acadia, during King William's War. A large force of New England provincial troops arrived before Port Royal. The Governor of Acadia Louis-Alexandre des Friches de Menneval had only 70 soldiers; the unfinished enceinte remained open and its 18 cannon had not been brought into firing positions; 42 young men of Port-Royal were absent.

zh.s: 皇家港战役于1690年5月19日在阿卡迪亚首府皇家港爆发，是威廉王战争的一部分。一支新英格兰殖民地军队抵达皇家港。阿卡迪亚总督路易-亚历山大·德·梅讷瓦尔·德·弗里什仅有70名士兵；未完工的城防墙仍有缺口，18门大炮也尚未部署到发射阵地；皇家港还有42名青年男子不在城中。

en.s: The Battle of the Cedars (French: Bataille des Cèdres) was a series of military confrontations in the early stages of the American Revolutionary War that occurred during the Continental Army's invasion of Quebec, which began in September 1775. These skirmishes, which involved limited combat, occurred in May 1776 at and around the Cedars, 45 km (28 mi) west of Montreal, Quebec.
en.n: American Revolutionary War: A Continental Army garrison surrenders in the Battle of The Cedars.

zh.s: 雪松之战是美国独立战争初期的一系列军事冲突，发生在大陆军入侵魁北克期间；这场入侵始于1775年9月。1776年5月，双方在魁北克省蒙特利尔以西45公里（28英里）的雪松镇及周边发生了几场规模有限的交战。
zh.n: 美国独立战争：大陆军一处驻军在雪松之战中投降。

en.s: The Battle of Mas Deu or Battle of Mas d'Eu on 19 May 1793 saw the French Army of the Eastern Pyrenees under Louis-Charles de Flers fighting the Spanish Army of Catalonia led by Antonio Ricardos. The Spanish drove the outnumbered French soldiers out of their camp near Mas Deu and compelled them to retreat to Perpignan. The victory enabled the Spanish forces to lay siege to the Fort de Bellegarde which dominated the best road through the Pyrenees from Barcelona into France. For the next month, Ricardos was preoccupied by the Siege of Bellegarde.

zh.s: 马斯德乌战役又称马斯德尤战役，于1793年5月19日爆发，交战双方是路易-夏尔·德·弗莱尔率领的东比利牛斯法军和安东尼奥·里卡多斯率领的加泰罗尼亚西班牙军。西班牙军迫使人数较少的法军撤出马斯德乌附近的营地，并退往佩皮尼昂。此役胜利使西班牙军得以围攻贝勒加德堡。该堡控制着从巴塞罗那经比利牛斯山进入法国的最佳道路。此后一个月里，里卡多斯一直忙于贝勒加德围城战。

en.t: First Battle of Sant Llorenç de la Muga
en.s: The First Battle of Sant Llorenç de la Muga (Catalan) or Spanish: San Lorenzo de la Muga) (19 May 1794) between a Spanish army commanded by the Luis Firmín de Carvajal, Conde de la Unión and a French army led by Jacques François Dugommier. Two weeks earlier, the French had driven the Spanish army from French territory in the Second Battle of Boulou.

zh.t: 第一次圣洛伦索德拉穆加战役
zh.s: 第一次圣洛伦索德拉穆加战役于1794年5月19日爆发，交战双方是路易斯·菲尔明·德·卡瓦哈尔·德拉乌尼翁伯爵率领的西班牙军队，以及雅克-弗朗索瓦·迪戈米耶率领的法国军队。两周前，法军在第二次布卢战役中将西班牙军队赶出法国领土。

en.s: The National Order of the Legion of Honour (French: Ordre national de la Légion d'honneur [ɔʁdʁ nɑsjɔnal d(ə) la leʒjɔ̃ dɔnœʁ] ), formerly the Imperial Order of the Legion of Honour (Ordre impérial de la Légion d'honneur), is the highest and most prestigious French national institution, both military and civil. It consists of five classes and was originally established in 1802 by Napoleon Bonaparte.

zh.s: 法国国家荣誉军团勋章（法语：Ordre national de la Légion d'honneur）曾称帝国荣誉军团勋章（Ordre impérial de la Légion d'honneur），是法国最高、最受尊崇的军事与民事荣誉。勋章分为5个等级，最初由拿破仑·波拿巴于1802年设立。

en.s: The Battle of Almaraz was a battle of the Peninsular War which took place on 18/19 May 1812, in which the Anglo-Portuguese Army under Lord Hill destroyed a French pontoon bridge across the River Tagus, in Almaraz, Spain. The bridge was protected by two French garrisons at either end. The action was swift-moving, deceptive, and daring.

zh.s: 阿尔马拉斯战役是半岛战争中的一场战役，于1812年5月18日至19日爆发。希尔勋爵率领的英葡联军摧毁了西班牙阿尔马拉斯的塔霍河浮桥。桥梁两端都有法军驻守。这次行动迅速、出其不意，也十分大胆。

en.s: The Tariff of 1828 was a very high protective tariff that became law in the United States on May 19, 1828. It was a bill designed to fail in Congress because it was seen by free trade supporters as hurting both industry and farming, but it passed anyway. The bill was vehemently denounced in the South and escalated to a threat of civil war in the nullification crisis of 1832–33.
en.n: This entry records the signing, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1828年关税法于1828年5月19日在美国生效，是一项税率很高的保护性关税法。支持自由贸易者认为法案会同时损害工业和农业，原本希望它在国会无法通过，但法案最终仍获通过。南方各州强烈谴责该法，最终在1832至1833年的废止危机中引发内战威胁。

en.s: The Buffalo Grove ambush was an ambush that occurred on May 19, 1832 as part of the Black Hawk War. A six-man detail carrying dispatches from United States Colonel James M. Strode at Galena, Illinois to General Henry Atkinson at Dixon's Ferry was ambushed by Native Americans during the attack. William Durley was killed and buried near the site of the ambush. Durley's remains were initially interred by the party that would become victims of the St. Vrain massacre. Two other men had bullet holes in their clothing, but were uninjured.

zh.s: 布法罗格罗夫伏击战发生于1832年5月19日，是黑鹰战争的一部分。一支六人小队奉命将密件从伊利诺伊州加利纳的詹姆斯·M·斯特罗德上校处送往迪克森渡口的亨利·阿特金森将军处，途中遭原住民袭击。威廉·德利阵亡，遗体葬在伏击地点附近。最初安葬德利遗体的队伍后来在圣弗兰大屠杀中遇害。另有两人衣服上被子弹击穿，但本人没有受伤。

en.s: The Fort Parker massacre, also known as the Fort Parker raid, was an attack carried out by a contingent of Comanche, Kiowa, Caddo, and Wichita raiders at Fort Parker on May 19, 1836, where a group of Texians was killed.

zh.s: 帕克堡大屠杀又称帕克堡袭击，是科曼奇、基奥瓦、卡多和威奇托武装人员于1836年5月19日对帕克堡发动的袭击，造成一群得克萨斯居民死亡。

en.t: Expedition of the Col des Beni Aïcha
en.s: The Expedition of the Col des Beni Aïcha, or the Expedition of Thénia, or simply Beni Aïcha Expedition, was an expedition in May 1837, during the French conquest of Algeria. This event pitted the troupes coloniales under Colonel Maximilien Joseph Schauenburg against the troops of Beni Aïcha of the Igawawen.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 贝尼艾查山口远征又称泰尼亚远征或贝尼艾查远征，发生于1837年5月，是法国征服阿尔及利亚期间的一次远征。远征中，马克西米利安·约瑟夫·绍恩堡上校率领法国殖民军，与伊加瓦文人的贝尼艾查部队交战。

en.s: The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo officially ended the Mexican–American War (1846–1848). It was signed on the 2nd of February 1848 in the town of Guadalupe Hidalgo. After the defeat of its army and the fall of the capital in September 1847, Mexico entered into peace negotiations with the U.S. envoy, Nicholas Trist.
en.n: Mexican–American War: Mexico ratifies the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo, thus ending the war and ceding California, Nevada, Utah and parts of four other modern-day U.S. states to the United States for US$15 million.

zh.t: 瓜达卢佩-伊达尔戈条约
zh.s: 《瓜达卢佩-伊达尔戈条约》正式结束了美墨战争（1846—1848年）。条约于1848年2月2日在瓜达卢佩-伊达尔戈镇签署。1847年9月墨西哥军队战败、首都陷落后，墨西哥开始与美国特使尼古拉斯·特里斯特进行和平谈判。
zh.n: 美墨战争：墨西哥批准《瓜达卢佩-伊达尔戈条约》，结束战争，并将加利福尼亚州、内华达州、犹他州以及现今美国另外四个州的部分地区割让给美国，换取1500万美元。

en.s: The Town of New Plymouth by-election 1865 was a by-election held in the Town of New Plymouth electorate during the 3rd New Zealand Parliament, on 19 May 1865. The by-election was caused by the resignation of the incumbent, Charles Brown, and was won unopposed by Henry Sewell. Whilst Sewell was not a local resident, he was a member of the government through his appointment to the Legislative Council, the upper house of Parliament. Sewell accepted the invitation to represent the electorate, as him becoming a member of the lower house was seen to strengthen the government.

zh.s: 1865年新普利茅斯镇选区补选于1865年5月19日举行，属于新西兰第三届议会任期内的补选。现任议员查尔斯·布朗辞职后举行补选，亨利·休厄尔自动当选。休厄尔并非当地居民，但因获任上议院立法委员会成员而成为政府成员。他接受代表该选区的邀请，因为当时认为他进入下议院有助于加强政府。

en.s: The Battle of Cầu Giấy or Paper Bridge, fought on 19 May 1883, was one of the numerous clashes during the Tonkin Campaign (1883–86) between the French and the Black Flags. A small French force under the command of capitaine de vaisseau Henri Rivière attacked a strong Black Flag defensive position near the village of Cầu Giấy a few miles to the west of Hanoi, known to the French as Paper Bridge (Pont de Papier).

zh.s: 纸桥战役又称交纸桥战役，于1883年5月19日爆发，是1883年至1886年东京战役期间法军与黑旗军之间多次冲突之一。一支由海军上校亨利·里维埃尔指挥的小规模法军，进攻了纸桥（法语：Pont de Papier）附近黑旗军的坚固防线。纸桥位于河内以西数英里处。

en.t: Buffalo Bill's first Buffalo Bill's Wild West opens in Omaha, Nebraska
en.s: William Frederick Cody (February 26, 1846 – January 10, 1917), better known as Buffalo Bill, was an American soldier, bison hunter, and showman. One of the most famous figures of the American Old West, Cody began performing at the age of 23. He performed in shows that displayed cowboy themes and episodes from the frontier and Indian Wars.

zh.t: 布法罗比尔的“狂野西部秀”首次在内布拉斯加州奥马哈上演
zh.s: 威廉·弗雷德里克·科迪（1846年2月26日—1917年1月10日），以“布法罗比尔”之名闻名，是美国军人、野牛猎手和演艺人士。他是美国旧西部最著名的人物之一，23岁开始登台表演，节目以牛仔生活、边疆故事和印第安战争为主题。

en.s: The 1885 United States Senate election in Illinois was held from February 18 to May 19, 1885. The contentious election was determined by a joint session of the Illinois General Assembly. Incumbent Republican United States Senator John A. Logan, seeking a third term (second consecutive) in the United States Senate, was unanimously nominated by a Republican caucus. en.s: The 1888 World Championship was an exhibition football match that took place in Glasgow, Scotland, on 19 May 1888 between the winners of the Scottish Cup, Renton, and the English FA Cup, West Bromwich Albion. The match was won by Renton who beat Albion 4–1. This was not the first "World Championship" game between English and Scottish sides; however, the next edition was the first such club competition contested between national league winners (as the leagues had not been yet created before that time).

zh.s: 1888年世界冠军赛是一场表演足球赛，于1888年5月19日在苏格兰格拉斯哥举行，由苏格兰杯冠军伦顿对阵英格兰足总杯冠军西布罗姆维奇。伦顿以4比1获胜。这并非英格兰和苏格兰球队之间的首场“世界冠军赛”；但下一届赛事是首次由两国联赛冠军参赛的俱乐部比赛（当时两国联赛尚未成立）。

en.s: The Battle of Dos Ríos was fought in Cuba during its war of independence from Spain. It was a rearguard action fought by the Cuban Liberation Army against Spanish forces, which allowed the rebels to escape to the west of the island. Casualty figures vary but on the rebel side included revolutionary leader José Martí.

en.t: Parks Canada, the world's first national park service, is established as the Dominion Parks Branch under the Department of the Interior
en.s: Parks Canada (French: Parcs Canada) is the agency of the Government of Canada which manages the country's 37 National Parks, 11 national park reserves, 5 National Marine Conservation Areas, 171 National Historic Sites, one National Urban Park (Rouge), and one National Landmark (Pingo). Parks Canada is mandated to "protect and present nationally significant examples of Canada's natural and cultural heritage, and foster public understanding, appreciation, and enjoyment in ways that ensure their ecological and commemorative integrity for present and future generations".

zh.t: 加拿大公园管理局成立，成为世界上首个国家公园管理机构
zh.s: 加拿大公园管理局（法语：Parcs Canada）是加拿大政府的机构，负责管理该国37座国家公园、11处国家公园保护区、5处国家海洋保护区、171处国家历史遗址、1座国家城市公园（鲁日）和1处国家地标（平戈）。该机构肩负使命：保护并展示具有国家重要性的自然与文化遗产，并以确保其生态完整性和纪念价值得以延续的方式，促进公众理解、欣赏和享受这些遗产，惠及今世后代。

en.s: The third attack on Anzac Cove (19 May 1915) was an engagement during the Gallipoli Campaign of the First World War. The attack was conducted by the forces of the Ottoman Turkish Empire, against the forces of the British Empire defending the cove. On 25 April 1915, the Australian and New Zealand Army Corps (ANZAC) landed on the western side of the Gallipoli Peninsula, at what thereafter became known as Anzac Cove.

zh.s: 第三次安扎克湾进攻于1915年5月19日发生，是第一次世界大战加里波利战役期间的一场交战。奥斯曼帝国军队进攻了守卫海湾的英帝国部队。1915年4月25日，澳新军团在加里波利半岛西侧登陆，之后该地被称为安扎克湾。

en.t: The Norwegian football club Rosenborg BK is founded
en.s: Rosenborg Ballklub, commonly referred to simply as Rosenborg (Urban East Norwegian: [ˈrùːsn̩bɔrɡ]) or RBK, is a Norwegian professional football club from Trondheim that plays in Eliteserien. The club has won a record 26 league titles, a shared record 12 Norwegian Football Cup titles and have played more UEFA matches than any other Norwegian team. RBK play their home games at the all-seater Lerkendal Stadion which has a capacity of 21,421.

zh.t: 挪威足球俱乐部罗森博格成立
zh.s: 罗森博格足球俱乐部，通常简称罗森博格或RBK，是来自挪威特隆赫姆、参加挪威足球超级联赛的职业足球俱乐部。球队创纪录地赢得26次联赛冠军，并以12次挪威杯冠军与其他球队并列纪录；其参加的欧足联赛事场次超过其他挪威球队。RBK的主场是全座席的莱肯达尔体育场，可容纳21,421人。

en.s: The City of London by-election, 1922 was a parliamentary by-election held on 19 May 1922 for the British House of Commons constituency of City of London, which covered the "Square Mile" which was the United Kingdom's traditional financial district. The seat had become vacant on the elevation to the peerage of one of the constituency's two Conservative Members of Parliament (MPs), Arthur James Balfour, as the Earl of Balfour. Balfour had held the seat since a by-election in 1906, following his defeat at Manchester East in the 1906 general election. He had also been Prime Minister between 1902 and 1905.

zh.s: 1922年伦敦市选区补选于1922年5月19日举行，选出英国下议院伦敦市选区议员。该选区涵盖“平方英里”范围，是英国传统金融区。保守党两名议员之一阿瑟·詹姆斯·贝尔福获封伯爵后辞去议席，促成补选。贝尔福自1906年在曼彻斯特东区大选失利后举行的补选中当选以来一直担任该席议员；他还曾于1902年至1905年担任英国首相。

en.s: The Vladimir Lenin All-Union Pioneer Organization, shortened to the Young Pioneers, was a youth organization of the Soviet Union for children and adolescents ages 9–14 that existed between 1922 and 1991.

en.t: Finnish cavalry general C. G. E. Mannerheim is appointed the field marshal
en.s: Baron Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim (Finland Swedish: [kɑːrl ˈɡʉstɑv ˈeːmil ˈmɑnːærhejm] , 4 June 1867 – 27 January 1951) was a Finnish military commander and statesman. He served as the military leader of the Whites in the Finnish Civil War (1918), as regent of Finland (1918–1919), as commander-in-chief of the Finnish Defence Forces during World War II (1939–1945), and as the president of Finland (1944–1946).

zh.t: 芬兰骑兵将领C·G·E·曼纳海姆获任陆军元帅
zh.s: 卡尔·古斯塔夫·埃米尔·曼纳海姆男爵（芬兰瑞典语发音：[kɑːrl ˈɡʉstɑv ˈeːmil ˈmɑnːærhejm]；1867年6月4日—1951年1月27日）是芬兰军事指挥官和政治家。他在1918年芬兰内战中领导白军，1918年至1919年担任芬兰摄政，二战期间（1939—1945年）任芬兰国防军总司令，并于1944年至1946年担任芬兰总统。

en.s: The 1936 New Jersey Republican presidential primary was held on May 19, 1936, in New Jersey as one of the Republican Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1936 United States presidential election. Delegates to the 1936 Republican National Convention were elected from each of the state's congressional districts, along with four delegates at-large. Kansas governor Alf Landon won in a landslide, sweeping a majority of delegates, and defeating Idaho senator William Borah.

zh.s: 1936年新泽西州共和党总统初选于1936年5月19日在新泽西州举行，是共和党为1936年美国总统选举举行的州级提名竞选之一。各国会选区选出代表参加1936年共和党全国代表大会，另选出四名全州代表。堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登以压倒性优势获胜，赢得大多数代表，并击败爱达荷州参议员威廉·博拉。

en.s: The Levant Crisis, also known as the Damascus Crisis, the Syrian Crisis, or the Levant Confrontation, was a military confrontation that took place between British and French forces in Syria in May 1945 soon after the end of World War II in Europe. French troops had tried to quell nationalist protests in Syria against the continued occupation of the Levant by France.

zh.s: 黎凡特危机又称大马士革危机、叙利亚危机或黎凡特冲突，是二战在欧洲结束后不久，英国和法国军队于1945年5月在叙利亚发生的军事对峙。法国军队试图镇压叙利亚民族主义者的抗议；抗议者反对法国继续占领黎凡特地区。

en.s: The Battle of Siping (Chinese: 四平保卫战) was a battle between the Nationalists and the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) for the control of Siping in 1946 during the Chinese Civil War. This campaign was characterized by the fact that the supreme commanders of both sides had overestimated their strength and set unrealistic goals, but in both cases, the frontline commanders on both sides averted the potential catastrophes by convincing their respective supreme commanders to change their original decisions.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 四平战役是1946年中国内战期间，国民党和中国共产党争夺四平控制权的一场战役。战役期间，双方最高指挥官都高估了己方实力、设定了不切实际的目标；但双方前线指挥官都说服各自的最高指挥官改变原定决策，避免了可能发生的灾难性后果。

en.s: The South Amboy powder pier explosion was an incident that took place on Friday, May 19, 1950. Over 420 tons of explosives in transit at the Raritan River Port in South Amboy, New Jersey detonated due to unknown causes, killing 31 and injuring over 350.

zh.t: 南安博伊火药码头爆炸
zh.s: 南安博伊火药码头爆炸发生于1950年5月19日（星期五）。停靠在新泽西州南安博伊拉里坦河港口、正在运输的420多吨炸药因不明原因爆炸，造成31人死亡、350多人受伤。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 19 May 1956 to elect the 75 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The Labor government was seeking its ninth continuous term in office since the 1932 election; it would be Vince Gair's second election as Premier. Labor would not win another election in the state until 1989.

zh.s: 澳大利亚昆士兰州于1956年5月19日举行选举，选出州立法议会75名议员。工党政府争取自1932年以来连续第九次执政；这也是文斯·盖尔担任州长后的第二次选举。工党此后直到1989年才再次赢得该州选举。

en.s: The battle of Remada took place in May 1958, three months after the bombing of Sakiet Sidi Youssef. The battle opposed Tunisian forces to the French forces at Remada.

zh.s: 雷马达战役发生于1958年5月，距萨基耶特西迪优素福遭轰炸三个月。交战双方是突尼斯军队和法国军队，战场位于雷马达。

en.t: The North Vietnamese Army establishes Group 559, whose responsibility is to determine how to maintain supply lines to South Vietnam; the resulting route is the Ho Chi Minh trail
en.s: Group 559 was a transportation and logistical unit of the People's Army of Vietnam. Established on 19 May 1959 to move troops, weapons, and materiel from North Vietnam to Vietcong paramilitary units in South Vietnam, the unit created and maintained the Ho Chi Minh Trail, the supply line that helped the North win the Vietnam War.

zh.t: 北越军队成立559部队，负责规划通往南越的补给线；后来形成的路线即胡志明小道
zh.s: 559部队是越南人民军的运输和后勤单位，1959年5月19日成立，负责把部队、武器和物资从北越运往南越的越共武装力量。该部队修建并维护了胡志明小道，这条补给线帮助北越赢得越南战争。

en.s: The Venera program (Russian: Вене́ра, pronounced [vʲɪˈnʲɛrə] 'Venus') was a series of space probes developed by the Soviet Union between 1961 and 1984 to gather information about the planet Venus. A total of eighteen probes were sent, including two related Vega probes. Thirteen probes successfully entered the Venusian atmosphere, including the two Venera-Halley probes. Ten of those successfully landed on the surface of the planet.
en.n: Venera program: Venera 1 becomes the first man-made object to fly by another planet by passing Venus (the probe had lost contact with Earth a month earlier and did not send back any data).

zh.s: 金星计划（俄语：Вене́ра，意为“金星”）是苏联于1961年至1984年间实施的一系列太空探测计划，旨在收集金星的信息。苏联共发射了18艘探测器，其中包括两艘相关的“织女星”探测器。13艘探测器成功进入金星大气层，其中包括两艘金星—哈雷探测器；这13艘中有10艘成功在金星表面着陆。
zh.n: 金星计划：金星1号飞掠金星，成为首个飞经另一颗行星的人造物体（该探测器早在一个月前便与地球失去联系，没有传回任何数据）。

en.s: 1962 Egypt Cup final, was the final match of the 1961–62 Egypt Cup, was between Zamalek and Al Ittihad Alexandria, Zamalek won the match 5–1.

zh.s: 1962年埃及杯决赛是1961—62赛季埃及杯的决赛，由扎马雷克对阵亚历山大伊蒂哈德。扎马雷克以5比1获胜。

en.s: The 1965 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match between 1860 Munich of West Germany and West Ham United of England. The final was held at Wembley Stadium in London on 19 May 1965. It was the final match of the 1964–65 European Cup Winners' Cup and the fifth European Cup Winners' Cup final since the competition's inception.

zh.s: 1965年欧洲优胜者杯决赛于1965年5月19日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由西德慕尼黑1860对阵英格兰西汉姆联。比赛决出了1964—65赛季欧洲优胜者杯冠军，也是该赛事创办后的第五届决赛。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on May 19, 1968. Democrazia Cristiana (DC) remained stable around 38% of the votes. They were marked by a victory of the Communist Party (PCI) passing from 25% of 1963 to c. 30% at the Senate, where it presented jointly with the new Italian Socialist Party of Proletarian Unity (PSIUP), which included members of Socialist Party (PSI) which disagreed the latter's alliance with DC. PSIUP gained c. 4.5% at the Chamber. The Socialist Party and the Democratic Socialist Party (PSDI) presented together as the Unified PSI–PSDI, but gained c. 15%, far less than the sum of what the two parties had obtained separatedly in 1963.

zh.s: 意大利于1968年5月19日举行大选。基督教民主党（DC）的得票率保持在约38%。共产党（PCI）得票上升，从1963年的25%提高到参议院选举中的约30%，表现突出。该党在参议院选举中与新成立的意大利无产阶级统一社会党（PSIUP）共同参选；PSIUP包括反对社会党（PSI）与DC结盟而脱党的人士。PSIUP在众议院选举中获得约4.5%的选票。社会党与民主社会党（PSDI）组成统一社会党—民主社会党联盟参选，得票约15%，远低于两党在1963年分别参选时的得票总和。

en.s: Lombardy elected its fifth delegation to the Italian Senate on May 19, 1968. This election was a part of the national Italian general election of 1968 even if, according to the Italian Constitution, every senatorial challenge in each Region is a single and independent race. The election was won by the centrist Christian Democracy, as it happened at a national level.

zh.t: 1968年伦巴第大区意大利参议院选举
zh.s: 伦巴第大区于1968年5月19日选出意大利参议院第五批议员。这是1968年意大利全国大选的一部分。根据意大利宪法，各大区的参议院选举都各自独立进行。与全国结果一样，中间派基督教民主党赢得该大区选举。

en.s: The 1972 AFC Asian Cup final was a football match which determined the winner of the 1972 AFC Asian Cup, the 5th edition of the AFC Asian Cup, a quadrennial tournament contested by the men's national teams of the member associations of the Asian Football Confederation. It was the first time that a final match was held in the AFC Asian Cup since the previous four editions were held in a round-robin format.

zh.s: 1972年亚足联亚洲杯决赛决出了第5届亚洲杯冠军。亚洲杯每四年举办一次，由亚足联成员协会的男子国家队参赛。此前四届赛事均采用循环赛制，这是亚洲杯首次举行单场决赛。

en.s: The 1973 Victorian state election, held on Saturday, 19 May 1973, was for the 46th Parliament of Victoria. It was held in the Australian state of Victoria to elect the 73 members of the state's Legislative Assembly and 18 members of the 36-member Legislative Council. Rupert Hamer succeeded Henry Bolte as Premier of Victoria on 23 August 1972.

zh.s: 1973年维多利亚州选举于1973年5月19日（星期六）举行，选出维多利亚州第46届议会议员。选举在澳大利亚维多利亚州举行，改选州立法议会73个席位和36席立法委员会中的18席。鲁珀特·哈默于1972年8月23日接替亨利·博尔特，出任维多利亚州州长。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in France in 1974, following the death of President Georges Pompidou. They went to a second round, and were won by Valéry Giscard d'Estaing by a margin of 1.6%. It is to date the closest presidential election in French history.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 乔治·蓬皮杜总统去世后，法国于1974年举行总统选举。选举进入第二轮，瓦莱里·吉斯卡尔·德斯坦以1.6个百分点的优势获胜。这是迄今法国历史上竞争最激烈的一次总统选举。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框中标注的第二轮日期。

en.s: On 19 May 1977, the English association football clubs Coventry City and Bristol City contested a match in the Football League First Division at Highfield Road, Coventry. It was the final game of the 1976–77 Football League season for both clubs, and both faced possible relegation to the Second Division. A third club, Sunderland, were also in danger of relegation and were playing their final game at the same time, against Everton at Goodison Park.

zh.t: 考文垂城2比2布里斯托尔城（1977年）
zh.s: 1977年5月19日，英格兰足球俱乐部考文垂城和布里斯托尔城在考文垂的海菲尔德路球场进行足球联赛甲级比赛。这是两队1976—77赛季的最后一场比赛，两队都可能降入乙级联赛。另一支同样面临降级危险的球队桑德兰，也在同一时间于古迪逊公园对阵埃弗顿，进行赛季最后一场比赛。

en.s: The elections to the Seventh Kerala Assembly were held on May 19, 1982.

zh.s: 第七届喀拉拉邦立法议会选举于1982年5月19日举行。

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in the Indian state of West Bengal in 1982. The Left Front, which had won the 1977 West Bengal Legislative Assembly election, emerged victoriously. The Indian National Congress emerged as the main opposition party in the state, as the Janata Party was disintegrating.

zh.t: 1982年西孟加拉邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 1982年，印度西孟加拉邦举行立法议会选举。此前在1977年赢得选举的左翼阵线再次获胜。印度国民大会党成为该邦主要反对党，当时人民党正在分裂。

en.s: Elections to the Haryana Legislative Assembly were held in the Indian state of Haryana in May 1982. No party gained a majority of seats. Incumbent Chief Minister Bhajan Lal of Congress staked claim to form government, was sworn in, and later proved his majority in the assembly. He remained the Chief Minister for the first 4 years of this assembly's term.

zh.t: 1982年哈里亚纳邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 1982年5月，印度哈里亚纳邦举行立法议会选举。没有政党赢得过半席位。时任首席部长、国大党成员巴詹·拉尔要求组建政府并宣誓就职，之后在议会证明自己获得多数支持。他在本届议会任期的前4年一直担任首席部长。

en.s: Elections to the Himachal Pradesh Legislative Assembly were held in May 1982, to elect members of the 68 constituencies in Himachal Pradesh, India. The Indian National Congress won the most seats as well as the popular vote, and Thakur Ram Lal was reappointed as the Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh.

zh.t: 1982年喜马偕尔邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 1982年5月，印度喜马偕尔邦举行立法议会选举，改选该邦68个选区的议员。印度国民大会党赢得最多席位和最多普选票，塔库尔·拉姆·拉尔再次出任该邦首席部长。

en.s: The 1984 Scottish Cup Final was played on 19 May 1984 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 99th Scottish Cup. The previous year's winners and defending champions in the match were Aberdeen who had beaten Rangers in the 1983 final. Aberdeen had beaten Dundee 2–0 in their semi-final to reach the final whereas Celtic had beaten St Mirren 2–1.

zh.s: 1984年苏格兰杯决赛于1984年5月19日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是第99届苏格兰杯决赛。上届冠军兼本场卫冕冠军阿伯丁曾在1983年决赛中击败流浪者。阿伯丁在半决赛中以2比0击败邓迪，晋级决赛；凯尔特人则以2比1击败圣米伦。

en.s: The 1984 FA Cup final was contested by Everton and Watford at Wembley. Everton won 2–0, with one goal by Graeme Sharp and a controversial goal from Andy Gray. He was adjudged by many to have fouled the Watford goalkeeper Steve Sherwood by heading the ball from Sherwood's hands. Everton had reached the final seven times previously, winning in 1906, 1933 and 1966.

zh.s: 1984年英格兰足总杯决赛由埃弗顿对阵沃特福德，在温布利举行。埃弗顿以2比0获胜，格雷姆·夏普打进一球，安迪·格雷打进一球，但这个进球引发争议：许多人认为他从沃特福德门将史蒂夫·舍伍德手中顶球时犯规。此前埃弗顿曾7次闯入决赛，并在1906年、1933年和1966年夺冠。

en.t: 1985 China v Hong Kong football match
en.s: China v Hong Kong was a 1986 FIFA World Cup qualification match played on 19 May 1985, noteworthy in that the surprise result caused deep dissatisfaction and hooliganism among Mainland Chinese football fans, leading to the match being immortalized as the May 19 Incident or 5.19 incident (Chinese: 五一九事件). Due to this controversy, the match rates as one of the most notable matches in the rivalry of the China PR national football team and the Hong Kong national football team. The game resulted in a 2–1 win to Hong Kong, with goals from Cheung Chi Tak in the 19th minute and Ku Kam Fai in the 60th-minute.

zh.s: 中国队对阵香港队的比赛于1985年5月19日举行，是1986年国际足联世界杯预选赛的一场比赛。香港队意外获胜，在中国大陆球迷中引发强烈不满和骚乱，这场比赛因此被称为“五一九事件”。它也成为中国国家足球队与香港国家足球队对抗史上最受关注的比赛之一。香港队以2比1获胜，张志德在第19分钟、顾锦辉在第60分钟进球。

en.s: The 1985 Indian Federation Cup final was the 9th final of the Indian Federation Cup, the top knock-out competition in India, and was contested between Kolkata giants East Bengal and Mohun Bagan on 19 May 1985 at the Sampangi Stadium in Bangalore, Karnataka. East Bengal won the final 1–0 courtesy of a goal by Jamshid Nassiri in the extra-time to claim their third Federation Cup title.

zh.s: 1985年印度联邦杯决赛是印度顶级淘汰制足球赛事联邦杯的第9届决赛，于1985年5月19日在卡纳塔克邦班加罗尔的桑潘吉体育场举行，由加尔各答两支劲旅东孟加拉和莫亨巴根争夺冠军。东孟加拉凭借詹姆希德·纳西里的加时赛进球，以1比0获胜，第三次赢得联邦杯。

en.t: The Firearm Owners Protection Act is signed into law by U.S. President Ronald Reagan
en.s: The Firearm Owners' Protection Act (FOPA) of 1986 is a United States federal law that revised many provisions of the Gun Control Act of 1968.

zh.t: 美国总统罗纳德·里根签署《枪支持有者保护法》
zh.s: 《1986年枪支持有者保护法》（FOPA）是美国联邦法律，对1968年《枪支管制法》的多项条款作了修订。

en.s: Capital Combat: Return of RoboCop was a one-time professional wrestling pay-per-view event from the National Wrestling Alliance held under the World Championship Wrestling name. Capital Combat took place on May 19, 1990, at the D.C. Armory in Washington, D.C. The show featured a promotional crossover with the imminent release of RoboCop 2, with RoboCop rescuing Sting from an attack by the Four Horsemen during the PPV. The main event of the show was a steel cage match with Ric Flair defending the NWA World Heavyweight Championship against Lex Luger.

zh.s: 《首都之战：机械战警归来》是由国家摔角联盟以世界摔角冠军赛名义举办的一次性付费电视职业摔角赛事，于1990年5月19日在华盛顿特区军械库举行。赛事与即将上映的《机械战警2》合作宣传，节目中机械战警救下了遭四骑士袭击的Sting。主赛是瑞克·弗莱尔对阵莱克斯·卢格的钢笼赛，弗莱尔卫冕NWA世界重量级冠军。

en.s: The 1990 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1989–90 DFB-Pokal, the 47th season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 19 May 1990 at the Olympiastadion in West Berlin. 1. FC Kaiserslautern won the match 3–2 against Werder Bremen to claim their first cup title, qualifying for the 1990–91 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 1990 DFB-Supercup.

zh.s: 1990年德国杯决赛决出了1989—90赛季德国杯冠军，这是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的第47个赛季。比赛于1990年5月19日在西柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。凯泽斯劳滕以3比2击败云达不莱梅，首次夺得德国杯，并获得参加1990—91赛季欧洲优胜者杯和1990年德国超级杯的资格。

en.s: Croatia held an independence referendum on 19 May 1991, following the Croatian parliamentary elections of 1990 and the rise of ethnic tensions that led to the breakup of Yugoslavia. With 83 percent turnout, voters approved the referendum, with 93 percent in favor of independence.

zh.s: 克罗地亚于1991年5月19日举行独立公投，背景是1990年克罗地亚议会选举之后民族紧张局势加剧，最终导致南斯拉夫解体。投票率为83%，其中93%的选民支持独立。

en.s: The 1991 Welsh Cup final saw Swansea City win the Welsh Cup for the tenth time, by beating Wrexham 2–0 at National Stadium in the 104th Welsh Cup Final. This was Wrexham's second consecutive final, having lost 2–1 to English side Hereford United the previous season. The win gave Swansea their second campaign in a European competition, in the 1991–92 European Cup Winners' Cup, in three years after their Welsh Cup triumph in 1989.

zh.s: 1991年威尔士杯决赛中，斯旺西城以2比0击败雷克瑟姆，第10次赢得威尔士杯。这是第104届威尔士杯决赛，比赛在国家体育场举行。雷克瑟姆连续第二年闯入决赛；上届决赛中，他们以1比2负于英格兰球队赫里福德联。斯旺西赢得冠军后，将在1991—92赛季参加欧洲优胜者杯。这是球队继1989年夺得威尔士杯后，三年内第二次参加欧洲赛事。

en.s: The 1992 Kurdistan Region general election was held in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq on 19 May 1992 to elect the president and the 105 members of the Kurdistan National Assembly. It was the first free and fair election in the history of the Kurdistan Region, held just one year after the 1991 Kurdish uprisings against the Ba’ath regime.

en.s: The 1996 Slamboree was the fourth Slamboree professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The event took place on May 19, 1996 from the Riverside Centroplex in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The key feature of the event was a Lord of the Ring tournament, in which wrestlers were randomly paired in Lethal Lottery tag team matches to qualify for a Battlebowl battle royal and the winner of that battle royal would earn a title shot at the WCW World Heavyweight Championship.

zh.s: 《Slamboree 1996》是世界摔角冠军赛（WCW）举办的第四届《Slamboree》付费电视赛事，于1996年5月19日在路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日的河滨中心举行。本届赛事的主要环节是“擂台之王”锦标赛：摔角手随机组队参加“致命彩票”双打赛，胜者晋级Battlebowl皇家大战，皇家大战的获胜者将获得WCW世界重量级冠军挑战资格。

en.s: STS-77 was the 77th Space Shuttle mission and the 11th mission of the Space Shuttle Endeavour. The mission began from launch pad 39B from Kennedy Space Center, Florida on 19 May 1996 lasting 10 days and 40 minutes and completing 161 revolutions before landing on runway 33. The defense and aerospace technology company L'Garde was responsible for the design and manufacture of the Antenna in the Inflatable Antenna Experiment, a key component of the STS-77 mission.

zh.s: STS-77是第77次航天飞机任务，也是“奋进号”航天飞机的第11次任务。任务于1996年5月19日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心39B发射台升空，持续10天40分钟，完成161圈飞行后在33号跑道着陆。国防和航空航天技术公司L'Garde负责设计和制造“充气式天线实验”中的天线，这是STS-77任务的关键部分。

en.t: The Sierra Gorda biosphere, the most ecologically diverse region in Mexico, is established as a result of grassroots efforts
en.s: The Sierra Gorda (lit. 'fat mountain(s)') is an ecological region centered on the northern third of the Mexican state of Querétaro and extending into the neighboring states of Guanajuato, Hidalgo and San Luis Potosí. Within Querétaro, the ecosystem extends from the center of the state starting in parts of San Joaquín and Cadereyta de Montes municipalities and covering all of the municipalities of Peñamiller, Pinal de Amoles, Jalpan de Serra, Landa de Matamoros and Arroyo Seco, for a total of 250 km2 of territory.

zh.s: 塞拉戈尔达（字面意思为“肥山”）是一个生态区域，核心位于墨西哥克雷塔罗州北部三分之一地区，并延伸至邻近的瓜纳华托州、伊达尔戈州和圣路易斯波托西州。在克雷塔罗州境内，该生态区从州中部的圣华金和卡德雷塔德蒙特斯部分地区延伸开来，覆盖佩尼亚米耶尔、皮纳尔德阿莫莱斯、哈尔潘德塞拉、兰达德马塔莫罗斯和阿罗约塞科等市镇，区域总面积为250平方公里。

en.s: The Fiji coup of 2000 was a complicated affair involving a civilian coup d'état by hardline i-Taukei nationalists against the elected government of a Fijian of Indian Descent Prime Minister, Mahendra Chaudhry, on 19 May 2000, the attempt by President Ratu Sir Kamisese Mara to assert executive authority on 27 May, and his own resignation, possibly forced, on 29 May. An interim government headed by Commodore Frank Bainimarama was set up, and handed power over to an interim administration headed by Ratu Josefa Iloilo, as President, on 13 July.

zh.s: 2000年斐济政变过程复杂，包括2000年5月19日由强硬派斐济本土民族主义者发动的平民政变，推翻印度裔斐济人总理马亨德拉·乔杜里领导的民选政府；5月27日总统卡米塞塞·马拉试图行使行政权；以及5月29日马拉辞职，辞职可能是被迫的。随后成立了由海军准将弗兰克·拜尼马拉马领导的临时政府，并于7月13日将权力移交给由拉图·何塞法·伊洛伊洛担任总统的临时行政当局。

en.s: Judgment Day (2002) was the fourth annual Judgment Day professional wrestling pay-per-view event and the first professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced under the WWE name. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Vietnam on 19 May 2002. A total of 759 candidates, including 125 independents, contested the election. The Vietnamese Fatherland Front was the only party to nominate candidates, and won 447 of the 498 seats. Voter turnout was reported to be 99%.

zh.s: 越南于2002年5月19日举行国会选举，共有759名候选人参选，其中125人为独立候选人。越南祖国阵线是唯一提名候选人的组织，赢得498个席位中的447席。投票率据报为99%。

en.s: The 2003–2004 Indonesian offensive in Aceh, also known as Integrated Operation (Indonesian: Operasi Terpadu) against the Free Aceh Movement (GAM) separatists was launched on 19 May 2003, and lasted nearly one year. It followed a two-week ultimatum to GAM to accept special autonomy under Indonesian rule. It was one of the Indonesian military's largest campaigns since the 1975 invasion of East Timor.

zh.s: 2003—2004年印尼亚齐攻势又称“综合行动”（印尼语：Operasi Terpadu），是印尼针对亚齐独立运动（GAM）分离主义者发动的军事行动，于2003年5月19日开始，持续近一年。行动开始前，印尼曾给GAM两周最后期限，要求其接受在印尼统治下实行特别自治。这是印尼军方自1975年入侵东帝汶以来规模最大的军事行动之一。

en.s: The 2004 UEFA Cup final was an association football match that took place on 19 May 2004 at Ullevi in Gothenburg, Sweden, contested between Spanish side Valencia and French side Olympique de Marseille. Valencia won the match 2–0, with goals from Vicente and Mista. This was the fourth major European trophy won by Valencia.

zh.s: 2004年欧洲联盟杯决赛于2004年5月19日在瑞典哥德堡的乌利维球场举行，由西班牙瓦伦西亚对阵法国马赛奥林匹克。瓦伦西亚以2比0获胜，进球者是维森特和米斯塔。这是瓦伦西亚赢得的第四座重要欧洲赛事奖杯。

en.s: WEC 15: Judgment Day was a mixed martial arts event promoted by World Extreme Cagefighting on May 19th 2005 at the Tachi Palace Hotel & Casino in Lemoore, California. The card featured the likes of Joe Riggs, Chris Lytle and James Irvin compete.

zh.s: WEC 15：《审判日》是世界极限笼斗赛事于2005年5月19日在加利福尼亚州利莫尔的塔奇宫酒店及赌场举办的综合格斗赛事。乔·里格斯、克里斯·莱特尔和詹姆斯·欧文等选手参加了比赛。

en.s: The 2006 Russian Cup final decided the winner of the 2005–06 Russian Cup, the 14th season of Russia's main football cup. It was played on 19 May 2006 at the Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow, between CSKA Moscow and Spartak Moscow. CSKA Moscow emerged victorious with a 3–0 win thanks to two goals from Jô and a strike from Vágner Love.

zh.s: 2006年俄罗斯杯决赛决出了2005—06赛季俄罗斯杯冠军，这是俄罗斯主要足球杯赛的第14个赛季。比赛于2006年5月19日在莫斯科卢日尼基体育场举行，由莫斯科中央陆军对阵莫斯科斯巴达克。中央陆军以3比0获胜，若和瓦格纳·洛夫各进一球，其中若梅开二度。

en.s: On the night of May 19–20, 2007, a mass shooting occurred in Moscow, Idaho, United States. Two people were killed and three others were injured before the perpetrator, 36-year-old Jason Hamilton, committed suicide. Prior to the shooting, Hamilton had killed his wife at their home.

zh.s: 2007年5月19日至20日夜间，美国爱达荷州莫斯科发生大规模枪击事件。事件造成两人死亡、三人受伤，36岁的枪手杰森·汉密尔顿随后自杀。枪击发生前，汉密尔顿已在家中杀害妻子。

en.s: The 2007 FA Cup final was played on Saturday, 19 May 2007 between Chelsea and Manchester United. It was the 126th FA Cup final and the first to be played at the new Wembley Stadium. Chelsea beat Manchester United 1-0 thanks to an extra-time goal from Didier Drogba, completing a domestic cup double for the Blues in the 2006–07 season, as they had already won the League Cup Final in February.

zh.s: 2007年英格兰足总杯决赛于5月19日星期六举行，由切尔西对阵曼联。这是第126届足总杯决赛，也是新温布利球场启用后举行的首场决赛。切尔西凭迪迪埃·德罗巴在加时赛中的进球，以1比0击败曼联。此前切尔西已在2月赢得联赛杯，因此这场胜利让球队在2006—07赛季完成国内杯赛双冠。

en.s: General elections were held in Malawi on 19 May 2009. Incumbent President Bingu wa Mutharika ran for re-election; his main opponent was John Tembo, the president of the Malawi Congress Party (MCP). Five other candidates also ran. The election was won by Mutharika, who was re-elected to the Presidency with around two-thirds of the vote. Mutharika's DPP also won a strong parliamentary majority.

zh.s: 马拉维于2009年5月19日举行大选。时任总统宾古·瓦·穆塔里卡竞选连任，主要对手是马拉维大会党主席约翰·滕博。另有五名候选人参选。穆塔里卡获得约三分之二的选票，成功连任总统；他领导的民主进步党也在议会赢得明显多数。

en.s: The California state special elections, 2009 were held on May 19, 2009 throughout the state of California. The elections were authorized by the State Legislature and Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger as a part of a budget signed into law on February 19, 2009. Voters voted on six ballot propositions, 1A through 1F, for the open 26th State Senate district seat, and in a primary for the open 32nd congressional district seat.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2009年5月19日举行州特别选举。州议会和州长阿诺·施瓦辛格批准举行此次选举，作为2月19日签署的一项预算方案的一部分。选民就六项公投提案（1A至1F）投票，还选出第26州参议员选区的空缺席位，并参加第32国会选区空缺席位的初选。

en.s: The Action of 19 May 2009 was a confrontation between the HSwMS Malmö of the Swedish Navy and Somali Pirates in the Gulf of Aden after the pirates attempted to seize a Greek cargo vessel. The commander of the HSwMS Malmö was Magnus Jönsson.

zh.s: 2009年5月19日，瑞典海军的马尔默号军舰在亚丁湾与索马里海盗发生交战。当时海盗试图劫持一艘希腊货船。马尔默号的指挥官是马格努斯·永松。

en.s: The 2010 Copa del Rey final was the 108th final since the tournament's establishment (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The match took place on 19 May 2010 at the Camp Nou, Barcelona. The match was contested by Sevillla FC and Atlético Madrid, and it was refereed by Manuel Mejuto González. Sevilla lifted the trophy for the fifth time in their history with a 2–0 victory.

zh.s: 2010年西班牙国王杯决赛是赛事创办以来的第108届决赛（其中有两个赛季曾同时举办两项彼此竞争的赛事）。比赛于2010年5月19日在巴塞罗那诺坎普球场举行，由塞维利亚对阵马德里竞技，裁判是曼努埃尔·梅胡托·冈萨雷斯。塞维利亚以2比0获胜，队史第五次捧起冠军奖杯。

en.s: The 2012 Brindisi school bombing occurred on May 19, 2012, when three gas cylinder bombs hidden in a large rubbish bin exploded in front of the Morvillo Falcone high school in Brindisi, Italy, killing one 16-year-old female student and injuring five others, one seriously.

zh.s: 2012年5月19日，意大利布林迪西的法尔科内-莫尔维洛高中门前，一个大型垃圾桶内藏匿的三个煤气罐炸弹爆炸，造成一名16岁女学生死亡、五人受伤，其中一人伤势严重。

en.s: The 2012 Football League Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 19 May 2012 at Wembley Stadium, London, between West Ham United and Blackpool. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.t: 2012年英格兰足球联赛冠军组附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2012年英格兰足球联赛冠军组附加赛决赛于2012年5月19日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由西汉姆联对阵布莱克浦。比赛决出最后一支从英格兰第二级别联赛英冠升入英超的球队。

en.t: 2012 Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia leadership election
en.s: The Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia (KSČM) held a leadership election on 19 May 2012. Incumbent leader Vojtěch Filip faced Stanislav Grospič. Potential candidates included Miroslav Grebeníček, Marta Semelová and Jiří Dolejš. Filip was reelected when he received 275 votes from delegates while Grospiš only 168 votes.

zh.t: 2012年波希米亚和摩拉维亚共产党领导人选举
zh.s: 波希米亚和摩拉维亚共产党（KSČM）于2012年5月19日举行领导人选举。现任领导人沃伊捷赫·菲利普与斯坦尼斯拉夫·格罗皮奇竞争。米罗斯拉夫·格雷贝尼切克、玛尔塔·塞梅洛娃和伊日·多莱什也被视为潜在候选人。菲利普获得代表投出的275票，格罗皮奇仅获168票，菲利普因此连任。

en.s: The 2012 UEFA Champions League final was an association football match which took place on Saturday, 19 May 2012 between Bayern Munich of Germany and Chelsea of England at the Allianz Arena in Munich, Germany. The match was to decide the winner of the 2011–12 season of the UEFA Champions League, Europe's premier club football tournament.

zh.s: 2012年欧洲冠军联赛决赛于2012年5月19日（星期六）在德国慕尼黑安联球场举行，由德国拜仁慕尼黑对阵英格兰切尔西，决出2011—12赛季欧洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事冠军。

en.s: The 2012 Heineken Cup Final was the final match of the 2011–12 Heineken Cup, the 17th season of Europe's top club rugby union competition. The match was played on 19 May 2012 at Twickenham Stadium in London, England. The final was between Ulster and defending champions Leinster. It was the first all-Ireland final in the competitions history, and the fifth all-nation final after 2003, 2005, 2007, and 2010.

zh.s: 2012年喜力杯决赛是2011—12赛季喜力杯的决赛，也是欧洲顶级俱乐部橄榄球赛事的第17个赛季。比赛于2012年5月19日在英格兰伦敦特威克纳姆球场举行，由阿尔斯特对阵卫冕冠军伦斯特。这是喜力杯首次出现两支爱尔兰球队争夺冠军，此前仅有过五次同一国家的球队会师决赛，分别是2003年、2005年、2007年和2010年。

en.s: Strikeforce: Barnett vs. Cormier was a mixed martial arts event held by Strikeforce. It took place on May 19, 2012, at the HP Pavilion in San Jose, California.

zh.s: Strikeforce：巴内特对阵科米尔是Strikeforce主办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2012年5月19日在加利福尼亚州圣何塞的惠普展馆举行。

en.s: The 2012 Deir ez-Zor bombing involved a car bomb blast in the Syrian city of Deir ez-Zor killing 9 people on 19 May 2012 during the Syrian Civil War. The blast that reportedly struck a parking lot for a military intelligence complex also injured 100 people.

zh.s: 2012年5月19日，叙利亚内战期间，代尔祖尔市发生汽车炸弹爆炸，造成9人死亡。爆炸据报击中一处军事情报设施的停车场，另有100人受伤。

en.s: The 2012 Malaysia FA Cup final was a football match which was played on 19 May 2012, to determine the champion of the 2012 Malaysia FA Cup. It was the final of the 23rd edition of the Malaysia FA Cup, competition organised by the Football Association of Malaysia. The final was played between Sime Darby and Kelantan. Kelantan has won their first Malaysia FA Cup title, after winning the match 1–0.

zh.s: 2012年马来西亚足总杯决赛于2012年5月19日举行，决出当届冠军。这是马来西亚足总杯第23届赛事的决赛，由森美兰达比对阵吉兰丹。吉兰丹以1比0获胜，首次赢得马来西亚足总杯。

en.s: The 2012 Scottish Cup Final was the 127th final of the Scottish Cup. The match took place at Hampden Park on 19 May 2012 and was contested by the Edinburgh derby rivals, Hibernian (Hibs) and Heart of Midlothian (Hearts). It was Hibs' 12th Scottish Cup Final and Hearts' 14th. It was also the first time the clubs had met in a Scottish Cup Final since 1896.

zh.s: 2012年苏格兰杯决赛是该赛事第127届决赛，于5月19日在汉普顿公园举行。对阵双方是爱丁堡德比对手希伯尼安和哈茨。这是希伯尼安第12次、哈茨第14次参加苏格兰杯决赛；两队上一次在决赛相遇是在1896年。

en.t: 2012 Czech Social Democratic Party presidential primaries
en.s: Presidential primaries to select the Czech Social Democratic Party candidate for the 2013 presidential elections were held in May 2012. The primaries were indirect, with only members of the party's Central Executive Committee able to vote. Jiří Dienstbier Jr. became the party's candidate after receiving 107 votes to the 35 against. Dienstbier's only rival was Jan Švejnar, who withdrew prior to voting taking place.

zh.t: 2012年捷克社会民主党总统候选人初选
zh.s: 捷克社会民主党于2012年5月举行总统候选人初选，为2013年总统选举确定候选人。初选采用间接方式，只有该党中央执行委员会成员有投票权。伊日·迪恩斯特比尔获得107票，35票反对，成为该党候选人。他唯一的对手扬·施韦纳尔在投票前退出。

en.s: Extreme Rules (2013) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It took place on May 19, 2013 at the Scottrade Center in St. Louis, Missouri. It was the fifth event under the Extreme Rules chronology, with the event having originated in 2009. Eight matches took place on the event's card and one pre-show match was streamed on YouTube. The theme of the event was that most matches are contested under hardcore wrestling regulations.The event received 231,000 buys, down from last year's event of 263,000.

zh.s: 《极限规则2013》是WWE主办的付费电视职业摔角赛事，于2013年5月19日在密苏里州圣路易斯的斯科特中心举行。这是自2009年赛事创办以来第五届《极限规则》。本届安排了八场正式比赛，另有一场预热赛通过YouTube直播。赛事主题是大多数比赛都按硬核摔角规则进行。本届赛事付费观看量为231,000次，低于上届的263,000次。

en.s: Rey del Ring (2013) (Spanish for "King of the Ring") was an annual professional wrestling major event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), which took place on May 19, 2013 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The main event was the Eponymous IWRG Rey del Ring tournament, the eleventh annual version of the tournament, IWRG's version of World Wrestling Entertainment's Royal Rumble event. 30 men competed in the Rey del Ring, which was won by Oficial 911 when he eliminated Eterno to claim the victory as well as the Rey del Ring Championship belt from previous champion Oficial Factor.

zh.s: 《擂台之王》（2013年，西班牙语意为“擂台之王”）是墨西哥摔角推广组织国际摔角革命团体（IWRG）举办的年度大型职业摔角赛事，于2013年5月19日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛是同名的IWRG《擂台之王》锦标赛，为该赛事第11届，也是IWRG版的WWE皇家大战。共有30名选手参赛，Oficial 911淘汰Eterno后夺冠，并从卫冕冠军Oficial Factor手中赢得《擂台之王》冠军腰带。

en.s: The 2013 Football League One play-off final was an association football match which was played on 19 May 2013 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Brentford and Yeovil Town to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from Football League One to the Football League Championship.

zh.t: 2013年英格兰足球联赛甲级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2013年英格兰足球联赛甲级附加赛决赛于2013年5月19日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由布伦特福德对阵约维尔镇，决出最后一支从英甲升入英格兰足球联赛冠军组的球队。

en.s: The 2013 OFC Champions League final was the final of the 2012–13 OFC Champions League, the 12th edition of the Oceania Cup, Oceania's premier club football tournament organized by the Oceania Football Confederation (OFC), and the 7th season under the current OFC Champions League name. The final was contested between two New Zealand teams, Waitakere United and Auckland City, at Arena 2 of Mount Smart Stadium in Auckland, New Zealand, on 19 May 2013.

zh.s: 2013年大洋洲冠军联赛决赛是2012—13赛季该项赛事的决赛，也是大洋洲杯第12届比赛、由大洋洲足球联合会（OFC）主办的大洋洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事的第七个赛季。决赛于2013年5月19日在新西兰奥克兰的芒特斯马特体育场2号球场举行，由两支新西兰球队怀塔科雷联和奥克兰城交锋。

en.s: The 2015 Colorado Springs mayoral election took place on April 7 and May 19, 2015, to elect the mayor of Colorado Springs, Colorado. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections. The election was officially nonpartisan. Incumbent Mayor Steve Bach, in office since 2011, announced that he would not seek a second term in office.

zh.t: 2015年科罗拉多斯普林斯市长选举
zh.s: 2015年科罗拉多斯普林斯市长选举于4月7日和5月19日举行，选出科罗拉多州科罗拉多斯普林斯市长。选举与当地其他选举同期举行，候选人不分党派。自2011年起担任市长的史蒂夫·巴赫宣布不竞选连任。

en.s: The 2015 Los Angeles elections were held on March 3, 2015, in Los Angeles, California. Voters elected candidates in a nonpartisan primary, with runoff elections scheduled for May 19, 2015. Seven of the fifteen seats in the City Council were up for election. Municipal elections in California are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 2015年洛杉矶选举于3月3日在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶举行。选民通过无党派初选选出候选人，决选安排在5月19日举行。市议会15个席位中有7个需要改选。加利福尼亚州市政选举依法不分党派，候选人的党派不会出现在选票上。

en.s: EgyptAir Flight 804 was a regularly scheduled international passenger flight from Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport to Cairo International Airport, operated by EgyptAir. On 19 May 2016 at 02:33 Egypt Standard Time (UTC+2), the Airbus A320 crashed into the Mediterranean Sea, killing all 66 occupants on board.

zh.s: 埃及航空804号班机是从巴黎戴高乐机场飞往开罗国际机场的定期国际客运航班，由埃及航空执飞。2016年5月19日埃及标准时间凌晨2时33分（UTC+2），空客A320客机坠入地中海，机上66人全部遇难。

en.s: The Rif Dimashq offensive (April–May 2016) was a Syrian Army offensive in the Rif Dimashq Governorate, that was launched in late April 2016, as part of the Syrian Civil War. The offensive resulted in the military's capture of the southern section of the rebel-held East Ghouta, as government forces exploited concurrent large-scale rebel infighting in East Ghouta that left around 500 rebels dead.

zh.t: 里夫大马士革省攻势（2016年4月至5月）
zh.s: 里夫大马士革省攻势是叙利亚内战期间，叙利亚政府军于2016年4月下旬在里夫大马士革省发动的军事行动。政府军趁东古塔地区反政府武装大规模内斗之机发动攻势，约500名反政府武装人员在内斗中死亡。最终，政府军夺取了反政府武装控制的东古塔南部。

en.s: Local elections were held in Iran on 19 May 2017 to elect members of the City and Village Councils simultaneously with the twelfth presidential election.

zh.s: 伊朗于2017年5月19日举行地方选举，同日举行第12届总统选举，选出市议会和乡村议会成员。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Iran on 19 May 2017 alongside local elections. Candidate registration took place from 11 to 15 April 2017. Incumbent president Hassan Rouhani was eligible to run for re-election. His main rivals were the conservatives' top candidate Ebrahim Raisi, the Islamic Coalition Party's Mostafa Mir-Salim and Mostafa Hashemitaba who was an independent. Rouhani was re-elected for a second term.

zh.s: 伊朗于2017年5月19日举行总统选举，同时举行地方选举。候选人登记于2017年4月11日至15日进行。时任总统哈桑·鲁哈尼有资格竞选连任，主要对手是保守派领军候选人易卜拉欣·莱希、伊斯兰联盟党候选人穆斯塔法·米尔-萨利姆，以及独立候选人穆斯塔法·哈希米塔巴。鲁哈尼再次当选，开始第二个任期。

en.s: An election to the Islamic City Council of Tehran took place on 19 May 2017, along with the local elections nationwide. The council is elected by the plurality-at-large voting system. This election saw losses for the Principlists and the Reformists gained all 21 seats. More than 3.6 million voters turned out in the election, setting a record.

zh.s: 德黑兰伊斯兰城市议会选举于2017年5月19日举行，与伊朗全国地方选举同日进行。议会采用多席位相对多数制选举。原则派在这次选举中失利，改革派赢得全部21个席位。投票人数超过360万，创下纪录。

en.s: The 2018 Scottish Cup Final was the 133rd final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 2017–18 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match took place at Hampden Park on 19 May 2018 and was contested by Celtic and Motherwell. The fixture was a repeat of the finals in 1931, 1933, 1951 and 2011, all of which were won by Celtic.

zh.s: 2018年苏格兰杯决赛是第133届苏格兰杯决赛，也是2017—18赛季的决赛。苏格兰杯是苏格兰最重要的淘汰制足球赛事。比赛于2018年5月19日在汉普顿公园球场举行，由凯尔特人对阵马瑟韦尔。这场对决重演了1931年、1933年、1951年和2011年的四届决赛，凯尔特人在那几次决赛中均获胜。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Maia vs. Usman
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Maia vs. Usman (also known as UFC Fight Night 129) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that was held on May 19, 2018, at Movistar Arena in Santiago, Chile.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：玛雅对阵乌斯曼
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：玛雅对阵乌斯曼（也称UFC格斗之夜129）是终极格斗冠军赛主办的综合格斗赛事，于2018年5月19日在智利圣地亚哥的莫维斯塔竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2018 FA Cup final was an association football match between Manchester United and Chelsea on 19 May 2018 at Wembley Stadium in London, England. It was the 137th FA Cup final overall and was the showpiece match of English football's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup (FA Cup), organised by the Football Association (FA).

zh.s: 2018年英格兰足总杯决赛于2018年5月19日在英格兰伦敦温布利球场举行，由曼联对阵切尔西。这是第137届英格兰足总杯决赛。赛事由英格兰足球总会主办，是英格兰主要足球杯赛——足球总会挑战杯的决赛。

en.s: A by-election for the Zlín Senate seat in the Czech Republic was held on 18 and 19 May 2018 as a result of František Čuba's resignation. The second round was heldr 25 and 26 May 2018. Michaela Blahová and Tomáš Goláň advanced to second round. The election was surprisingly won by Tomáš Goláň. Voter turnout was very low.

zh.s: 捷克兹林参议院选区于2018年5月18日和19日举行补选，起因是弗朗季谢克·丘巴辞职。第二轮投票于5月25日和26日举行。米哈埃拉·布拉霍娃和托马什·戈拉尼晋级第二轮。戈拉尼意外胜出，投票率很低。

en.s: The 2018 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2017–18 DFB-Pokal, the 75th season of the annual German football cup competition. The match was played on 19 May 2018 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. The final featured Bayern Munich, the record winners of the competition, and Eintracht Frankfurt, the runners-up of the previous season, making it a rematch of the 2006 final.

zh.s: 2018年德国杯决赛决出了2017—18赛季德国杯冠军，这是该项年度德国顶级淘汰制足球赛事的第75个赛季。比赛于2018年5月19日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。参赛双方是德国杯夺冠次数最多的拜仁慕尼黑，以及上届亚军法兰克福；两队也在重演2006年决赛。

en.s: The 71st annual Cannes Film Festival took place from 8 to 19 May 2018. Australian actress Cate Blanchett served as jury president for the main competition. Japanese filmmaker Hirokazu Kore-eda won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for his drama film Shoplifters, marking Japan's first win after more than twenty years. The official festival poster features Jean-Paul Belmondo and Anna Karina from Jean-Luc Godard's 1965 film Pierrot le Fou.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第71届戛纳电影节于2018年5月8日至19日举行。澳大利亚演员凯特·布兰切特担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。日本导演是枝裕和凭剧情片《小偷家族》获得电影节最高奖金棕榈奖，这是日本电影二十多年来首次获此奖。官方海报采用了让-吕克·戈达尔1965年电影《狂人皮埃罗》中让-保罗·贝尔蒙多和安娜·卡里娜的剧照。

en.t: Meeting of Wedding of Prince Harry and Meghan Markle
en.s: The wedding of Prince Harry and Meghan Markle was held on Saturday 19 May 2018 in St George's Chapel at Windsor Castle in the United Kingdom. The groom is a member of the British royal family; the bride is American and previously worked as an actress, blogger, charity ambassador, and advocate. On the morning of the wedding, Prince Harry's grandmother, Queen Elizabeth II, conferred upon him the titles of Duke of Sussex, Earl of Dumbarton and Baron Kilkeel.

zh.t: 哈里王子与梅根·马克尔婚礼
zh.s: 哈里王子与梅根·马克尔于2018年5月19日星期六在英国温莎城堡的圣乔治礼拜堂举行婚礼。新郎是英国王室成员；新娘是美国人，曾从事演艺、博客写作、慈善宣传和倡导工作。婚礼当天上午，哈里王子的祖母伊丽莎白二世女王授予他苏塞克斯公爵、邓巴顿伯爵和基尔基尔男爵头衔。

en.t: 2019 Indian general election in Madhya Pradesh
en.s: The 2019 Indian general election were held in Madhya Pradesh in 4 phases- between 29 April and 19 May 2019 to constitute the 17th Lok Sabha. Results declared on 23 May 2019.

zh.s: 2019年印度大选在中央邦分四个阶段举行，时间为4月29日至5月19日，选出第17届人民院议员。选举结果于2019年5月23日公布。

en.t: 2019 Indian general election in Uttar Pradesh
en.s: The 2019 Indian general election in Uttar Pradesh was held between 11 April and 19 May 2019 to constitute the 17th Lok Sabha. The election results were declared on 23 May which saw the BJP led alliance winning majority of seats.

zh.s: 2019年印度大选北方邦投票于4月11日至5月19日分阶段举行，选出第17届人民院议员。选举结果于5月23日公布，由印度人民党领导的联盟赢得多数席位。

en.s: The Rey del Ring (2019) show (Spanish for "King of the Ring") was an annual lucha libre supercard event produced and scripted by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), and took place on May 19, 2019 in Arena Naucalpan located in Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico.

zh.s: 2019年《擂台之王》（西班牙语意为“擂台之王”）是墨西哥摔角推广组织国际摔角革命团体（IWRG）主办并策划的年度摔角大型赛事，于2019年5月19日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。

en.s: The Allentown 2019 special mayoral election was held on May 19, 2019, following the resignation of Democratic mayor Ed Pawlowski. Incumbent interim Democratic mayor Ray O'Connell defeated Republican challenger Timothy Ramos.

zh.s: 阿伦敦2019年市长特别选举于2019年5月19日举行，起因是民主党市长埃德·帕夫洛夫斯基辞职。现任临时市长、民主党人雷·奥康奈尔击败了共和党挑战者蒂莫西·拉莫斯。

en.s: The 2019 A-League Grand Final was the fourteenth A-League Grand Final, the championship-deciding match of the A-League in Australia and the culmination of the 2018–19 season. It was played on the 19 May 2019 at Optus Stadium in Perth between Perth Glory and Sydney FC, who finished the regular season first and second respectively. This was the first A-League grand final hosted in Perth and it is the highest attended grand final in A-League history.

zh.t: 2019年澳大利亚足球联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2019年澳大利亚足球联赛总决赛是该赛事第14届总决赛，决出2018—19赛季冠军。比赛于2019年5月19日在珀斯的Optus体育场举行，由珀斯光荣对阵悉尼FC，两队在常规赛中分列第一和第二。这是澳大利亚足球联赛总决赛首次在珀斯举行，也是该赛事总决赛观众人数最多的一届。

en.s: The 2019 Indian general election in Punjab was held on 19 May 2019, making it seventh and the last phase of the election. Counting was held on 23 May 2019 and result was also declared on same day.

zh.s: 2019年印度大选旁遮普邦投票于2019年5月19日举行，这是全国选举第七阶段，也是最后阶段。计票和结果公布于5月23日进行。

en.t: 2019 Indian general election in Himachal Pradesh
en.s: The 2019 Indian general election held in India on 19 May 2019 to constitute the 17th Lok Sabha.

zh.t: 2019年印度大选喜马偕尔邦结果
zh.s: 2019年印度大选于2019年5月19日在印度举行，选出第17届人民院议员。

en.s: The 2019 Money in the Bank was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw, SmackDown, and 205 Live. It was the 10th annual Money in the Bank event and took place on May 19, 2019, at the XL Center in Hartford, Connecticut, which was the first held in May.

zh.s: 《合约阶梯大赛2019》是WWE主办的职业摔角付费电视和网络直播赛事，参赛选手来自Raw、SmackDown和205 Live等主力品牌。这是第十届年度《合约阶梯大赛》，于2019年5月19日在康涅狄格州哈特福德的XL中心举行，也是该赛事首次在5月举办。

en.s: The 2019 FA Trophy Final was a football match between AFC Fylde and Leyton Orient on 19 May 2019. It was the final match of the 2018–19 FA Trophy, the 50th season of the FA Trophy.

zh.s: 2019年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛于5月19日举行，由 AFC 菲尔德对阵莱顿东方，是2018—19赛季英格兰足总锦标赛的最后一场比赛，也是该赛事第50个赛季的决赛。

en.s: The 2019 FA Vase final was the 45th final of the Football Association's cup competition for teams at levels 9–11 of the English football league system. The match was contested between Chertsey Town, of the Combined Counties Premier Division, and Cray Valley Paper Mills, of the Southern Counties East Premier Division. This was the first time both teams had reached the final and the first visit to Wembley Stadium for both sides.

zh.s: 2019年英格兰足总花瓶杯决赛是英格兰足总杯赛的第45届决赛，参赛球队来自英格兰足球联赛系统第9至第11级。对阵双方是联合郡超级联赛的切特西镇和东南郡超级联赛的克雷谷造纸厂队。两队都是首次闯入决赛，也都是首次到温布利球场比赛。

en.t: 2019 Croatian national minorities councils and representatives elections
en.s: The 2019 Croatian national minorities' councils and representatives elections took place on 5 May. The elections were the fifth minority elections since 2003 and near 254,000 citizens of Croatia were entitled to vote on them. In total, 352 councils and 109 representatives were up for election. 14 minority groups were electing their councils while 20 minority groups were electing representatives. 6,686 candidates in total participated in elections which were conducted at 846 polling places.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2019年克罗地亚少数民族委员会及代表选举
zh.s: 2019年克罗地亚少数民族委员会及代表选举于5月5日举行。这是自2003年以来第五次少数民族选举，约有254,000名克罗地亚公民具备投票资格。此次共改选352个委员会和109名代表；14个少数民族群体选举委员会，20个群体选举代表。共有6,686名候选人参选，投票在846个投票站进行。

en.s: The 2020 Oregon Democratic presidential primary took place on May 19, 2020, in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election and was the only contest on that date. The Kentucky primary, previously also scheduled for May 19, was delayed due to the coronavirus pandemic, while Oregon already had a total vote-by-mail primary.

zh.t: 2020年俄勒冈州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年俄勒冈州民主党总统初选于2020年5月19日举行，是2020年民主党总统初选中当天唯一举行的竞选。肯塔基州初选原定同日举行，后来因新冠疫情推迟；俄勒冈州此前已决定采用邮寄投票方式。

en.s: On May 19, 2020, and November 3, 2020, elections were held in Portland, Oregon, to elect the mayor. In Portland local elections, all voters are eligible to participate. All candidates are listed on the ballot without any political party affiliation. All candidates meeting the qualifications competed in a blanket primary election on Tuesday, May 19, 2020.

zh.s: 美国俄勒冈州波特兰于2020年5月19日和11月3日举行市长选举。波特兰地方选举不设党派，所有选民均可参加，候选人以无党派身份列在选票上。符合资格的候选人于2020年5月19日（星期二）参加无差别初选。

en.s: The 2020 Oregon Republican presidential primary took place on May 19, 2020.

zh.t: 2020年俄勒冈州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年俄勒冈州共和党总统初选于2020年5月19日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Multnomah County District Attorney election was held on May 19, 2020, concurrent with the 2020 statewide general elections, to elect the District Attorney of Multnomah County, Oregon, which includes the major city of Portland. Oregon Criminal Justice Commission chair Mike Schmidt defeated Assistant United States Attorney Ethan Knight outright with 76.60%. Schmidt, by receiving over 50% of the votes in the primary, avoided a runoff election.

zh.t: 2020年马特诺玛县地方检察官选举
zh.s: 2020年马特诺玛县地方检察官选举于2020年5月19日举行，与俄勒冈州全州选举同期进行。马特诺玛县包括波特兰市。俄勒冈州刑事司法委员会主席迈克·施密特以76.60%的得票率直接击败助理联邦检察官伊桑·奈特当选。由于施密特在初选中得票超过50%，无需举行决选。

en.s: The 2020 Portland, Oregon, US City Commission elections were held on May 19, 2020, and November 3, 2020, with a special election on August 11, 2020. Three positions were up for election. Positions 1 and 2 were open due to the retirement of Amanda Fritz and the death of Nick Fish, respectively. Position 4 was held by Chloe Eudaly, who lost re-election.

zh.s: 2020年，美国俄勒冈州波特兰市政委员会选举于5月19日和11月3日举行，另于8月11日举行了一场特别选举。共有3个席位待选。第1和第2席位分别因阿曼达·弗里茨退休、尼克·菲什去世而空缺。克洛伊·尤德利竞选连任第4席位，但未能当选。

en.s: The 2020 Macon mayoral election took place on Tuesday, May 19, 2020, with a runoff election held on Tuesday, August 11, 2020. Incumbent Mayor Robert Reichert, the first mayor following the consolidation of Macon and Bibb County, was term-limited and could not run for re-election. After no candidate received a majority of the vote in the election, a runoff election was held, and County School Board President Lester Miller defeated Clifford Whitby, the former Chairman of the Macon-Bibb County Industrial Authority.

zh.s: 2020年梅肯市长选举于5月19日星期二举行，并于8月11日星期二进行决选。因任期限制，梅肯与比伯县合并后首任市长罗伯特·赖克特不能竞选连任。初选无人得票过半，因此举行决选；县教育委员会主席莱斯特·米勒击败梅肯—比伯县工业局前主席克利福德·惠特比，当选市长。

en.s: In 2020 heavy clashes between ex-Séléka groups erupted in N'Délé in Central African Republic. Fighting was largely along ethnic lines between Rounga factions of FPRC and ethnically Goula and Kara rebel groups.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

en.s: The 2021 Slovak Cup final (known as the Slovnaft Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the final match of the 2020–21 Slovak Cup, the 52nd season of the top cup competition in Slovak football. The match was played at the Tehelné pole in Bratislava, on 19 May 2021, contested by MŠK Žilina and ŠK Slovan Bratislava.

zh.s: 2021年斯洛伐克杯决赛因赞助原因也称斯洛瓦纳夫特杯决赛，是2020—21赛季斯洛伐克杯的最后一场比赛，也是斯洛伐克顶级足球杯赛的第52个赛季。比赛于2021年5月19日在布拉迪斯拉发的特赫内波莱球场举行，由日利纳对阵布拉迪斯拉发斯洛万。

en.s: The 2021 Croatian Cup final between Dinamo Zagreb and Istra 1961 was played on 19 May 2021 in Velika Gorica.

zh.s: 2021年克罗地亚杯决赛于5月19日在韦利卡戈里察举行，由萨格勒布迪纳摩对阵伊斯特拉1961。

en.s: The 2021 Bulgarian Cup final was the final match of the 2020–21 Bulgarian Cup and the 81st final of the Bulgarian Cup. The final took place on 19 May 2021 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. The clubs contesting the final were Arda Kardzhali and CSKA Sofia. For the symbolic hosts, this was their historic first cup final, while for CSKA, it was the 2nd consecutive and 34th overall.

zh.s: 2021年保加利亚杯决赛是2020—21赛季保加利亚杯的决赛，也是该项赛事第81届决赛。比赛于2021年5月19日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行，由阿尔达克尔贾利对阵索非亚中央陆军。对名义上的主队阿尔达克尔贾利来说，这是队史首次闯入杯赛决赛；中央陆军则是第34次参加决赛，也是连续第二年进入决赛。

en.s: The 2021 Coppa Italia final decided the winners of the 2020–21 Coppa Italia, Italy's main football cup. It was played on 19 May 2021 for the first time at the Mapei Stadium – Città del Tricolore, Reggio Emilia, between Atalanta and Juventus. Juventus won the match 2–1 for a record fourteenth title.

zh.s: 2021年意大利杯决赛决出了2020—21赛季意大利杯冠军。这是赛事首次在雷焦艾米利亚的三色城马佩体育场举行。比赛于2021年5月19日进行，由亚特兰大对阵尤文图斯。尤文图斯以2比1获胜，创纪录地第14次夺冠。

en.s: The 2021 Coupe de France final was a football match between Monaco and Paris Saint-Germain to decide the winner of the 2020–21 Coupe de France, the 104th season of the Coupe de France. It took place on 19 May at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis, Paris. Paris Saint-Germain won the final 2–0 for their record fourteenth Coupe de France title.

zh.s: 2021年法国杯决赛由摩纳哥对阵巴黎圣日耳曼，决出2020—21赛季法国杯冠军。这是法国杯第104个赛季。比赛于5月19日在巴黎圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行。巴黎圣日耳曼以2比0获胜，创纪录地第14次夺得法国杯冠军。

en.s: In May 2021, the Islamic State's West Africa Province (ISWAP) launched an invasion of the Sambisa Forest in Borno State, Nigeria, which was serving as the main base of Boko Haram, a rival jihadist rebel group. Following heavy fighting, ISWAP overran the Boko Haram troops, cornering their leader Abubakar Shekau. The two sides entered negotiations about Boko Haram's surrender during which Shekau committed suicide, possibly detonating himself with a suicide vest.

zh.s: 2021年5月，伊斯兰国西非省（ISWAP）入侵尼日利亚博尔诺州的桑比萨森林。该地是其敌对圣战组织博科圣地的主要基地。经过激战，ISWAP击溃博科圣地部队，将其领导人阿布巴卡尔·谢考逼入绝境。双方随后就博科圣地投降进行谈判，期间谢考自杀身亡；他可能引爆了自杀背心。

en.t: 2022 Bosnia and Herzegovina Football Cup final
en.s: The 2022 Bosnia and Herzegovina Football Cup final was an association football match played at Bilino Polje Stadium in Zenica, Bosnia and Herzegovina, on 19 May 2022. Sarajevo and Velež Mostar were the finalists. Velež won the trophy for the first time in the club's history. As winners, Velež qualified for the 2022–23 UEFA Europa Conference League.

zh.s: 2022年波黑足球杯决赛于2022年5月19日在波黑泽尼察的比利诺波列体育场举行。萨拉热窝和维列兹莫斯塔尔闯入决赛。维列兹首次赢得该项赛事冠军，并因此获得参加2022—23赛季欧洲协会联赛的资格。

en.s: The 2022 King Cup final was the 47th final of the King Cup, Saudi Arabia's main football knock-out competition since its inception in 1957. The final was played at the King Abdullah Sports City in Jeddah, on 19 May 2022. The match was contested by Al-Fayha and Al-Hilal. It was Al-Fayha's 1st King Cup final and Al-Hilal's 17th. This was the first meeting between these two sides in the King Cup.

zh.s: 2022年沙特国王杯决赛是该赛事第47届决赛。自1957年创办以来，国王杯一直是沙特阿拉伯主要的足球淘汰赛。决赛于2022年5月19日在吉达阿卜杜拉国王体育城举行，由费哈对阵利雅得新月。这是费哈首次闯入国王杯决赛，利雅得新月则是第17次进入决赛。这也是两队首次在国王杯中交锋。

en.s: The 2022 Cupa României final was the final match of the 2021–22 Cupa României and the 84th final of the Cupa României, Romania's premier football cup competition. It was played on 19 May 2022 between Sepsi OSK and Voluntari. Sepsi OSK claimed its first cup after a 2–1 victory in regular time. Marius Ștefănescu scored a double for the Sfântu Gheorghe side, and was thus named Man of the Match.

zh.s: 2022年罗马尼亚杯决赛是2021—22赛季罗马尼亚杯决赛，也是该赛事第84届决赛。比赛于2022年5月19日举行，由圣格奥尔基圣西尔维亚对阵沃伦塔里。圣西尔维亚在常规时间以2比1获胜，首次夺得杯赛冠军。圣西尔维亚的马里乌斯·斯特凡内斯库梅开二度，并当选全场最佳球员。

en.s: On 19 May 2024, an Iranian Air Force Bell 212 helicopter crashed near the village of Uzi, East Azerbaijan, Iran, killing President of Iran Ebrahim Raisi, Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, Governor-General of East Azerbaijan Malek Rahmati, representative of the supreme leader in East Azerbaijan Mohammad Ali Ale-Hashem, the head of the president's security team, and three flight crew.

zh.t: 2024年瓦尔扎甘直升机坠毁事故
zh.s: 2024年5月19日，一架伊朗空军贝尔212直升机在伊朗东阿塞拜疆省乌兹村附近坠毁。遇难者包括伊朗总统易卜拉欣·莱希、外交部长侯赛因·阿米尔-阿卜杜拉希扬、东阿塞拜疆省省长马利克·拉赫马蒂、最高领袖驻东阿塞拜疆省代表穆罕默德·阿里·阿勒-哈希姆、总统安保团队负责人，以及三名机组人员。

en.s: General elections were held in the Dominican Republic on 19 May 2024 to elect a president, vice-president, 32 senators, 190 deputies and 20 PARLACEN deputies. Incumbent President Luis Abinader won re-election to a second term with a majority of the vote in the first round, eliminating the need for a runoff.

zh.s: 多米尼加共和国于2024年5月19日举行大选，选出总统、副总统、32名参议员、190名众议员和20名中美洲议会议员。时任总统路易斯·阿比纳德尔在首轮投票中获得过半选票，成功连任第二个任期，无需举行第二轮投票。

en.t: 2024 Democratic Republic of the Congo coup attempt
en.s: On 19 May 2024, an attempted coup d'état took place in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Targeting President Félix Tshisekedi and his Economy Minister Vital Kamerhe, the assailants attacked both the Palais de la Nation and Kamerhe's residence. They were heavily armed and put up an intense fight at the Kamerhe home. At least one shell from the fighting detonated in the nearby capital of the Republic of the Congo, Brazzaville, causing several injuries.

zh.t: 2024年刚果民主共和国政变未遂
zh.s: 2024年5月19日，刚果民主共和国发生政变未遂。袭击者以总统费利克斯·齐塞克迪和经济部长维塔尔·卡梅雷为目标，袭击了国家宫和卡梅雷的住所。袭击者武装精良，在卡梅雷住所附近与守卫激烈交火。交火中至少有一枚炮弹落入邻国刚果共和国首都布拉柴维尔，造成数人受伤。

en.s: The 2024 EFL League Two play-off final was an association football match played on 19 May 2024 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Crewe Alexandra and Crawley Town. The match determined the fourth and final team to gain promotion from EFL League Two, the fourth tier of English football, to EFL League One.

zh.t: 2024年英格兰足球联赛乙级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2024年英格兰足球联赛乙级附加赛决赛于2024年5月19日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由克鲁亚历山德拉对阵克劳利镇。比赛决出最后一支从英格兰第四级别联赛英乙升入英甲的球队。

en.s: The 13th Federal Assembly of United Left was held in Madrid from 18 May to 19 May 2024, to renovate the governing bodies of the United Left (IU) and establish the party's main lines of action and strategy for the next leadership term. The leadership election takes place in order to replace Alberto Garzón as coordinator after he resigned in late November 2023.

zh.t: 西班牙统一左翼第13届联邦代表大会
zh.s: 西班牙统一左翼第13届联邦代表大会于2024年5月18日至19日在马德里举行，讨论改选该党的领导机构，并制定下一届领导班子的主要工作方向和策略。大会还将选出新协调员，接替于2023年11月底辞职的阿尔韦托·加尔松。
